hook.text_top: Her eyes turn red, then the fight starts.
hook.voice: They mocked her. Then her eyes turned red.

intro_voice: Here's the original, made with Seedance 2.5.

shots.excerpt: Medium shot, slow push-in: the kunoichi stands calmly, eyes lowered; an attacker reaches out to touch her ponytail bow mockingly. Full moon top left.
shots.voice: Shot 1. A medium shot with a slow push-in. A calm setup before the storm, under a full moon.

shots.excerpt: Close-up of her face, slow push-in: she lifts her gaze to the lens, her eyes ignite into glowing red light, and her smile widens into a grin.
highlight: eyes ignite into glowing red light
shots.voice: Shot 3. A close-up as her eyes ignite red. That one line flips the whole mood.

shots.excerpt: MUST SHOW: her palm strike explodes in a burst of glowing red energy. He is blasted backward down the corridor. Then a slow orbit around her ready stance.
shots.voice: Shot 5. Must show: a red energy burst on impact. Then a slow orbit around her stance.

shots.excerpt: Low angle: she leaps into a flying knee strike, both airborne in front of the full moon, the attacker engulfed in red energy. Slow motion.
shots.voice: Shot 8. A low angle flying knee against the full moon, in slow motion.

shots.excerpt: MUST SHOW: time nearly freezes: a huge translucent spherical shockwave bubble expands around the attacker, debris hanging mid-air, her body fully extended.
shots.voice: Shot 11. Time nearly freezes. A see-through shockwave bubble and debris hanging in the air.

outro_voice: The full prompt is in the caption. Follow Mira AI for a new one every day.
